manualFindings: Reviewed the v8.2.5 operation manual pages 15, 26, 40 and 41. The history and download instructions now describe a single PNG for the ordinary screen and project folders for MCP. Development verification results are excluded.
findings: Reviewed the changed history, ordinary download, restoration, and release instructions against the running app. Compared the unchanged sections with the previously audited candidate. Both languages distinguish ordinary single-PNG downloads and the MCP project export, and the changelog includes flexible panels and the one-time network retry.

pricingReview.findings: Compared Standard rates on both official tables. GPT-6 Luna is $0.10 input, $0.01 cached and $0.50 output per million short-context tokens. Listed GPT-6.2 and GPT-5.6 route prices match. GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst image input/output is $8/$30 per million. Gemini 3.8 Flash is $0.75/$3.75 per million through December 31, 2026 and Nano Banana 2.1 is $0.0336 per 1K image. Updated reference dates. Standard and Batch are distinct.
